classes.method: all 343 misses: a stored record with quote_score>=0.5 is taken by a sibling gold item whose quote overlaps the missed item's >=0.5 (recall_diag.py); gold-wide 385 of 2,113 live real items have a near-identical (>=0.9) earlier sibling in the same law
classes.proposal: build_gold.py: dedupe missed items against all existing items in the law, not only other missed items (line ~313 kept_m); bulk additions (line ~288) skip an obligation_id whose quote already matches an item, and take expected_fields from the record only when its quote matches (else ids from an older generation give misaligned agencies, e.g. 2017-A11227-17..21)

classes.method: upper bound: drops by cap_not_duty|benefit_entitlement|amount_not_duty (186) whose quote has 'not exceed|in excess of|no more than|not more than' = 53; only those whose number changed in new matter qualify
classes.proposal: apply the Nov 12 cap ruling at the gate: when the capped number is inside {{ }} and the cap limits a government power, keep it as a power with extends_existing true

classes.method: misses whose matching stored record is_act_clause (score_gold.py skips them before matching); corpus-wide 711 stored records quote 'This act shall take effect' and all 711 are extends_existing
classes.proposal: score_gold.py: match act-clause records like any other and count them as act_clause_records only when no live gold item matches; or drop act-clause items from gold if they are policy-excluded. The scorer and gold currently disagree

classes.method: ratio in the sample's non-duplicate, non-act-clause remainder (16 of 45) applied to the corpus remainder (343-153-52=138)
classes.proposal: mark these items not_real or excluded in gold_overrides.json (report-topic items, criterion items, aid limits, placeholder quote, reprinted text, applicability clauses)

classes.method: re-ask check joint_actor_single flags 36 laws corpus-wide
classes.proposal: split a record whose actor_raw joins two government bodies with and/or into one record per actor at ingest

classes.method: dropped/*.json rule sub_item_of_parent (152 total): 20 quotes match 'appointed by|designated by|nominated by', 9 start with an infinitive/action verb or 'Procedures'
classes.proposal: exempt from sub_item_of_parent any item naming its own appointer ('to be appointed by the X') and any item under a 'shall'/'shall have the following powers and duties' lead (Nov 12 list ruling); restore those dropped records

classes.class: not_extracted (list items, single sentences, skipped laws)
classes.method: sample ratio 11/136 on 343 misses; corpus-wide the re-ask queue holds 5,182 uncovered new-matter shall/may sentences in 1,514 laws (check b_modal_sentence_coverage) and 1,087 laws with c_list_items_fewer_records; data/deferred_skipped.json holds 89 skipped laws
classes.proposal: re-ask by check c_list_items_fewer_records first (list items), then span-level re-ask for the 89 deferred_skipped laws (2 of 11 sample misses); single-sentence misses have no shared shape a rule can catch

classes.method: all 6 nonsibling-taken misses, plus the sample share of partial_stored (3 of 9) and not_extracted (1 of 18) that are the same provision with a different quote window
classes.proposal: score_gold.py: match on containment of the gold quote's longest new-matter run or a 0.35 threshold with same agency+kind; use one quote per record (quote before quote_original) so one record cannot win for two items

classes.method: dropped quotes: 'vacanc' under condition_of_other_record|sub_item_of_parent = 7; 'may exempt|may waive' under exemption_or_applicability = 3; designation_no_actor with '(designated|appointed|selected|approved) by (the|such) X' = 4 (the re-ask check dropped_designation_with_actor flags 36 laws)
classes.proposal: designation_no_actor must not fire when the quote names the designator; exemption_or_applicability must not fire on 'X may exempt from disclosure'; vacancy filling is the appointer's duty (decide once, record in criteria.md)
